title: World's 100 Best Coffee Shops Database
description_html: Explore a historical, snapshot-driven database of The World's 100 Best Coffee Shops rankings — track rank changes, newcomers, dropouts, and consistent performers across editions.

shop_finder.title: Shop Finder
shop_finder.description: Search coffee shops by name, city, or country. Shows each shop's rank in the latest snapshot along with location and contact details. Use '=' prefix in name for an exact match (e.g. =Blue Bottle Coffee). Default limit: 100.
shop_finder.sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT id FROM snapshots ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT r.rank, COALESCE(sd.name, r.name_on_page) AS name, sh.slug, COALESCE(sd.city, '') AS city, COALESCE(sd.country, r.country_on_page) AS country, sd.website, sd.instagram, sd.description FROM rankings r JOIN latest ON r.snapshot_id = latest.id JOIN shops sh ON r.shop_id = sh.id LEFT JOIN shop_details sd ON sd.shop_id = r.shop_id AND sd.snapshot_id = r.snapshot_id WHERE (CASE WHEN :name IS NULL OR :name = '' THEN 1=1 WHEN SUBSTR(:name,1,1) = '=' THEN COALESCE(sd.name, r.name_on_page) = SUBSTR(:name,2) ELSE LOWER(COALESCE(sd.name, r.name_on_page)) LIKE LOWER('%' || :name || '%') END) AND (:city IS NULL OR :city = '' OR LOWER(COALESCE(sd.city,'')) LIKE LOWER('%' || :city || '%')) AND (:country IS NULL OR :country = '' OR LOWER(COALESCE(sd.country, r.country_on_page,'')) LIKE LOWER('%' || :country || '%')) ORDER BY r.rank ASC LIMIT COALESCE(NULLIF(:limit,''), 100)

rank_timeline.title: Rank Timeline
rank_timeline.description: Track a shop's rank across every historical snapshot. Filter by name (use '=' prefix for exact match), slug, city, or country. Results ordered by name then most recent snapshot first. Default limit: 200.
rank_timeline.sql: SELECT sn.snapshot_date, r.rank, COALESCE(sd.name, r.name_on_page) AS name, sh.slug, COALESCE(sd.city, '') AS city, COALESCE(sd.country, r.country_on_page) AS country FROM rankings r JOIN snapshots sn ON r.snapshot_id = sn.id JOIN shops sh ON r.shop_id = sh.id LEFT JOIN shop_details sd ON sd.shop_id = r.shop_id AND sd.snapshot_id = r.snapshot_id WHERE (CASE WHEN :name IS NULL OR :name = '' THEN 1=1 WHEN SUBSTR(:name,1,1) = '=' THEN COALESCE(sd.name, r.name_on_page) = SUBSTR(:name,2) ELSE LOWER(COALESCE(sd.name, r.name_on_page)) LIKE LOWER('%' || :name || '%') END) AND (:slug IS NULL OR :slug = '' OR sh.slug = :slug) AND (:city IS NULL OR :city = '' OR LOWER(COALESCE(sd.city,'')) LIKE LOWER('%' || :city || '%')) AND (:country IS NULL OR :country = '' OR LOWER(COALESCE(sd.country, r.country_on_page,'')) LIKE LOWER('%' || :country || '%')) ORDER BY COALESCE(sd.name, r.name_on_page), sn.snapshot_date DESC LIMIT COALESCE(NULLIF(:limit,''), 200)

snapshot_leaderboard.title: Snapshot Leaderboard
snapshot_leaderboard.description: Full ranked list for any historical snapshot. Uses the latest snapshot per year; snapshot_date accepts either YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD. Leave blank for the latest yearly edition. Optionally filter by name (supports '=' exact match), city, and country. Default limit: 200.
snapshot_leaderboard.sql: WITH yearly_snapshots AS (SELECT s.id, s.snapshot_date FROM snapshots s JOIN (SELECT SUBSTR(snapshot_date,1,4) AS snapshot_year, MAX(snapshot_date) AS snapshot_date FROM snapshots GROUP BY snapshot_year) y ON s.snapshot_date = y.snapshot_date), target AS (SELECT id, snapshot_date FROM yearly_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date = COALESCE(NULLIF(:snapshot_date,''), (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM yearly_snapshots)) OR (NULLIF(:snapshot_date,'') IS NOT NULL AND SUBSTR(snapshot_date,1,4) = NULLIF(:snapshot_date,'')) ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT r.rank, COALESCE(sd.name, r.name_on_page) AS name, sh.slug, COALESCE(sd.city, '') AS city, COALESCE(sd.country, r.country_on_page) AS country, sd.website, sd.instagram, target.snapshot_date FROM rankings r JOIN target ON r.snapshot_id = target.id JOIN shops sh ON r.shop_id = sh.id LEFT JOIN shop_details sd ON sd.shop_id = r.shop_id AND sd.snapshot_id = r.snapshot_id WHERE (CASE WHEN :name IS NULL OR :name = '' THEN 1=1 WHEN SUBSTR(:name,1,1) = '=' THEN COALESCE(sd.name, r.name_on_page) = SUBSTR(:name,2) ELSE LOWER(COALESCE(sd.name, r.name_on_page)) LIKE LOWER('%' || :name || '%') END) AND (:city IS NULL OR :city = '' OR LOWER(COALESCE(sd.city,'')) LIKE LOWER('%' || :city || '%')) AND (:country IS NULL OR :country = '' OR LOWER(COALESCE(sd.country, r.country_on_page,'')) LIKE LOWER('%' || :country || '%')) ORDER BY r.rank ASC LIMIT COALESCE(NULLIF(:limit,''), 200)

country_breakdown.title: Country Breakdown
country_breakdown.description: Distribution of ranked coffee shops by country for a given snapshot — shows shop count, best rank, average rank, and a list of shops with their positions. Uses the latest snapshot per year; snapshot_date accepts either YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD. Leave blank for the latest yearly edition. Optionally filter by name (supports '=' exact match), city, and country. Default limit: 50.
country_breakdown.sql: WITH yearly_snapshots AS (SELECT s.id, s.snapshot_date FROM snapshots s JOIN (SELECT SUBSTR(snapshot_date,1,4) AS snapshot_year, MAX(snapshot_date) AS snapshot_date FROM snapshots GROUP BY snapshot_year) y ON s.snapshot_date = y.snapshot_date), target AS (SELECT id FROM yearly_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date = COALESCE(NULLIF(:snapshot_date,''), (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM yearly_snapshots)) OR (NULLIF(:snapshot_date,'') IS NOT NULL AND SUBSTR(snapshot_date,1,4) = NULLIF(:snapshot_date,'')) ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC LIMIT 1), ranked AS (SELECT COALESCE(sd.country, r.country_on_page) AS country, COALESCE(sd.city, '') AS city, r.rank, COALESCE(sd.name, r.name_on_page) AS name FROM rankings r JOIN target ON r.snapshot_id = target.id LEFT JOIN shop_details sd ON sd.shop_id = r.shop_id AND sd.snapshot_id = r.snapshot_id) SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS shop_count, MIN(rank) AS best_rank, ROUND(AVG(rank), 1) AS avg_rank, GROUP_CONCAT(rank || '. ' || name, ' | ') AS shops FROM ranked WHERE (CASE WHEN :name IS NULL OR :name = '' THEN 1=1 WHEN SUBSTR(:name,1,1) = '=' THEN name = SUBSTR(:name,2) ELSE LOWER(name) LIKE LOWER('%' || :name || '%') END) AND (:city IS NULL OR :city = '' OR LOWER(city) LIKE LOWER('%' || :city || '%')) AND (:country IS NULL OR :country = '' OR LOWER(country) LIKE LOWER('%' || :country || '%')) GROUP BY country ORDER BY shop_count DESC, best_rank ASC LIMIT COALESCE(NULLIF(:limit,''), 50)

biggest_movers.title: Biggest Movers
biggest_movers.description: Shops with the largest rank changes between two consecutive yearly editions (latest snapshot per year). snapshot_date accepts either YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD. Leave blank to compare the latest yearly edition with its predecessor year. Optionally filter by name (supports '=' exact match), city, country, and direction ('climbed'/'dropped'). Default limit: 50.
biggest_movers.sql: WITH yearly_snapshots AS (SELECT s.id, s.snapshot_date FROM snapshots s JOIN (SELECT SUBSTR(snapshot_date,1,4) AS snapshot_year, MAX(snapshot_date) AS snapshot_date FROM snapshots GROUP BY snapshot_year) y ON s.snapshot_date = y.snapshot_date), target AS (SELECT id, snapshot_date FROM yearly_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date = COALESCE(NULLIF(:snapshot_date,''), (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM yearly_snapshots)) OR (NULLIF(:snapshot_date,'') IS NOT NULL AND SUBSTR(snapshot_date,1,4) = NULLIF(:snapshot_date,'')) ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC LIMIT 1), prev AS (SELECT id, snapshot_date FROM yearly_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date < (SELECT snapshot_date FROM target) ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC LIMIT 1), curr AS (SELECT shop_id, rank FROM rankings WHERE snapshot_id = (SELECT id FROM target)), prv AS (SELECT shop_id, rank FROM rankings WHERE snapshot_id = (SELECT id FROM prev)) SELECT COALESCE(sd.name, r.name_on_page) AS name, sh.slug, COALESCE(sd.city, '') AS city, COALESCE(sd.country, r.country_on_page) AS country, prv.rank AS previous_rank, curr.rank AS current_rank, (prv.rank - curr.rank) AS rank_change, CASE WHEN prv.rank > curr.rank THEN 'climbed' ELSE 'dropped' END AS direction, (SELECT snapshot_date FROM target) AS snapshot_date, (SELECT snapshot_date FROM prev) AS compared_to FROM curr JOIN prv ON curr.shop_id = prv.shop_id JOIN shops sh ON curr.shop_id = sh.id JOIN rankings r ON r.shop_id = curr.shop_id AND r.snapshot_id = (SELECT id FROM target) LEFT JOIN shop_details sd ON sd.shop_id = curr.shop_id AND sd.snapshot_id = (SELECT id FROM target) WHERE prv.rank != curr.rank AND (:direction IS NULL OR :direction = '' OR CASE WHEN prv.rank > curr.rank THEN 'climbed' ELSE 'dropped' END = :direction) AND (CASE WHEN :name IS NULL OR :name = '' THEN 1=1 WHEN SUBSTR(:name,1,1) = '=' THEN COALESCE(sd.name, r.name_on_page) = SUBSTR(:name,2) ELSE LOWER(COALESCE(sd.name, r.name_on_page)) LIKE LOWER('%' || :name || '%') END) AND (:city IS NULL OR :city = '' OR LOWER(COALESCE(sd.city,'')) LIKE LOWER('%' || :city || '%')) AND (:country IS NULL OR :country = '' OR LOWER(COALESCE(sd.country, r.country_on_page,'')) LIKE LOWER('%' || :country || '%')) ORDER BY ABS(prv.rank - curr.rank) DESC LIMIT COALESCE(NULLIF(:limit,''), 50)

newcomers_and_dropouts.title: Newcomers & Dropouts
newcomers_and_dropouts.description: Shops that entered or exited the ranking between two consecutive yearly editions (latest snapshot per year). snapshot_date accepts either YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD. Leave blank for the latest yearly edition vs its predecessor year. Optionally filter by status, name (supports '=' exact match), city, and country. Default limit: 100.
newcomers_and_dropouts.sql: WITH yearly_snapshots AS (SELECT s.id, s.snapshot_date FROM snapshots s JOIN (SELECT SUBSTR(snapshot_date,1,4) AS snapshot_year, MAX(snapshot_date) AS snapshot_date FROM snapshots GROUP BY snapshot_year) y ON s.snapshot_date = y.snapshot_date), target AS (SELECT id, snapshot_date FROM yearly_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date = COALESCE(NULLIF(:snapshot_date,''), (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM yearly_snapshots)) OR (NULLIF(:snapshot_date,'') IS NOT NULL AND SUBSTR(snapshot_date,1,4) = NULLIF(:snapshot_date,'')) ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC LIMIT 1), prev AS (SELECT id, snapshot_date FROM yearly_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date < (SELECT snapshot_date FROM target) ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC LIMIT 1), newcomers AS (SELECT 'newcomer' AS status, r.rank, r.shop_id, r.snapshot_id FROM rankings r WHERE r.snapshot_id = (SELECT id FROM target) AND r.shop_id NOT IN (SELECT shop_id FROM rankings WHERE snapshot_id = (SELECT id FROM prev))), dropouts AS (SELECT 'dropout' AS status, r.rank, r.shop_id, r.snapshot_id FROM rankings r WHERE r.snapshot_id = (SELECT id FROM prev) AND r.shop_id NOT IN (SELECT shop_id FROM rankings WHERE snapshot_id = (SELECT id FROM target))), combined AS (SELECT * FROM newcomers UNION ALL SELECT * FROM dropouts) SELECT c.status, c.rank, COALESCE(sd.name, r.name_on_page) AS name, sh.slug, COALESCE(sd.city, '') AS city, COALESCE(sd.country, r.country_on_page) AS country, CASE c.status WHEN 'newcomer' THEN (SELECT snapshot_date FROM target) ELSE (SELECT snapshot_date FROM prev) END AS snapshot_date FROM combined c JOIN shops sh ON c.shop_id = sh.id JOIN rankings r ON r.shop_id = c.shop_id AND r.snapshot_id = c.snapshot_id LEFT JOIN shop_details sd ON sd.shop_id = c.shop_id AND sd.snapshot_id = c.snapshot_id WHERE (:status IS NULL OR :status = '' OR c.status = :status) AND (CASE WHEN :name IS NULL OR :name = '' THEN 1=1 WHEN SUBSTR(:name,1,1) = '=' THEN COALESCE(sd.name, r.name_on_page) = SUBSTR(:name,2) ELSE LOWER(COALESCE(sd.name, r.name_on_page)) LIKE LOWER('%' || :name || '%') END) AND (:city IS NULL OR :city = '' OR LOWER(COALESCE(sd.city,'')) LIKE LOWER('%' || :city || '%')) AND (:country IS NULL OR :country = '' OR LOWER(COALESCE(sd.country, r.country_on_page,'')) LIKE LOWER('%' || :country || '%')) ORDER BY c.status, c.rank ASC LIMIT COALESCE(NULLIF(:limit,''), 100)

consistent_performers.title: Consistent Performers
consistent_performers.description: Shops appearing in the most yearly editions (latest snapshot per year), with appearance percentage, best rank, and average rank. A high appearance_pct means the shop has featured consistently across years. Optionally filter by name (supports '=' exact match), city, and country. Default limit: 50.
consistent_performers.sql: WITH yearly_snapshots AS (SELECT s.id, s.snapshot_date FROM snapshots s JOIN (SELECT SUBSTR(snapshot_date,1,4) AS snapshot_year, MAX(snapshot_date) AS snapshot_date FROM snapshots GROUP BY snapshot_year) y ON s.snapshot_date = y.snapshot_date), total_count AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM yearly_snapshots), appearances AS (SELECT r.shop_id, COUNT(DISTINCT r.snapshot_id) AS snapshots_appeared, MIN(r.rank) AS best_rank, ROUND(AVG(r.rank), 1) AS avg_rank FROM rankings r JOIN yearly_snapshots ys ON r.snapshot_id = ys.id GROUP BY r.shop_id), latest AS (SELECT id FROM yearly_snapshots ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT COALESCE(sd.name, sh.slug) AS name, sh.slug, COALESCE(sd.country, '') AS country, COALESCE(sd.city, '') AS city, a.snapshots_appeared, ROUND(100.0 * a.snapshots_appeared / tc.total, 1) AS appearance_pct, a.best_rank, a.avg_rank, sd.website, sd.instagram FROM appearances a JOIN shops sh ON a.shop_id = sh.id JOIN total_count tc LEFT JOIN shop_details sd ON sd.shop_id = a.shop_id AND sd.snapshot_id = (SELECT id FROM latest) WHERE (CASE WHEN :name IS NULL OR :name = '' THEN 1=1 WHEN SUBSTR(:name,1,1) = '=' THEN COALESCE(sd.name, sh.slug) = SUBSTR(:name,2) ELSE LOWER(COALESCE(sd.name, sh.slug)) LIKE LOWER('%' || :name || '%') END) AND (:city IS NULL OR :city = '' OR LOWER(COALESCE(sd.city,'')) LIKE LOWER('%' || :city || '%')) AND (:country IS NULL OR :country = '' OR LOWER(COALESCE(sd.country,'')) LIKE LOWER('%' || :country || '%')) ORDER BY a.snapshots_appeared DESC, a.avg_rank ASC LIMIT COALESCE(NULLIF(:limit,''), 50)

snapshots.description_html: One row per scraping run. snapshot_date is the unique identifier for a ranking edition. wayback_timestamp is non-null for Wayback Machine backfills.

columns.snapshot_date: Logical date of the ranking edition (UNIQUE)
columns.list_page_url: Exact URL used to fetch the ranking page for this snapshot
columns.wayback_timestamp: Wayback Machine timestamp; NULL for live scrapes
columns.scraped_at: Wall-clock time when this snapshot was inserted

shops.description_html: Stable identity table — one row per unique coffee shop. The slug is derived from the detail page URL path and never changes.

columns.created_at: Timestamp when this shop was first seen

rankings.description_html: One row per shop per snapshot. Records rank and display text exactly as it appeared on the list page. Use snapshot_id and shop_id to join with other tables.

columns.detail_page_url: Exact detail page URL as it appeared on the list page
columns.name_on_page: Shop name as it appeared on the list page
columns.country_on_page: Country as it appeared on the list page

shop_details.description_html: Detail page data for each shop in each snapshot — name, location, contact info, and description scraped from the shop's individual page. One row per (shop, snapshot) pair.

columns.name: Shop name parsed from detail page
columns.address: Full address parsed from detail page
columns.description: Multi-paragraph description from the detail page
columns.image_urls: JSON-encoded list of image URLs from the detail page
columns.is_wayback: 1 if this detail was fetched from the Wayback Machine, 0 for live scrape
